numeric.purpose: Stable fan percentages and preset values.

shadows.name: slider-thumb
shadows.purpose: Legibility for the white slider thumb on dark glass.

motion.name: glide
motion.purpose: Thumb, fill, frost reveal and halo for pointer jumps, presets and model changes. Keyboard is instant.

motion.name: melt
motion.purpose: Ice crown recedes when cooling is lowered.

motion.name: release-sweep
motion.purpose: Light runs back along the lit dots after a pointer release.

motion.name: aura
motion.purpose: Heat band change; a rising band breathes in once.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: System Reduce Motion removes all movement; static state remains.

narrative.overview: Aervane is a compact native macOS menu-bar instrument. Temperature leads; direct percentage control follows. Layout and controls carry state with minimal copy. Cooling power is rendered in ice, measured temperature in heat.
keyCharacteristics: Ice for cooling, heat for temperature

rules.name: The State Must Speak Rule
rules.body: Use plain-language state labels with semantic color; color never carries status alone.

rules.name: The Stable Number Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced digits for values that change during interaction.

rules.name: The Material First Rule
rules.body: Use native glass and tonal separation before adding shadow.

rules.name: The Two Families Rule
rules.body: Cooling is never warm and heat is never icy.

dos: Keep temperature first and the direct percentage control immediately available.
Preserve the hardware minimum and distinguish requested from measured speed.
donts: Do not add taglines, footers or section labels.
Do not describe preview as applied.
Do not add idle animation, timers or particles.
Do not let a heat state imply that manual control is blocked.
